depth_best_level.note: No published depth figure. MM program minimum sizes (10Y outright Tier 1: 10 contracts; Tier 2: 150; ETH: 5) are program terms, not measured depth.

median_spread_ticks_main.unit: ticks (best bid/offer spread equals the minimum tick > 99% of the day)
median_spread_ticks_main.quote: For all Treasury futures products, for example, best bid/offered price spreads matched corresponding contract minimum price increments throughout more than 99% of each trading day.
median_spread_ticks_main.note: Median not published; value inferred from '>99% of each trading day at the minimum increment'. ZN also: FEDS 2025-038 '94% of bid-ask spread observations are "stuck" at one tick' (March 2020). ZT's tick was halved in early 2019 (abstract-only, R8), after which no ZT spread figure was found.

depth_best_level.unit: contracts (average book size, front month outright)
depth_best_level.note: Columns: best level 2016, 2017, 2018, % growth; best 3 levels 2016, 2017, 2018, % growth. Not split by side; definition per CME. No later figure found.

touch_queue_size.note: Same as depth_best_level; no separate queue statistic published.

limit_hit_days_2019_2024.note: No CME notice, regulator report or press item reporting a Rule 589 halt in this product in 2019-2024 was found (one WebSearch on Treasury futures halts and dynamic circuit breakers; SER-8542 read). Gap, not a finding of zero. See A1_rates.md F8.

weekend_gap_exposure.note: Underlying is the US Treasury yield/price; no source fetched states that cash Treasuries trade while CME Globex is closed (Fri 4:00 p.m. CT to Sun 5:00 p.m. CT). Not crypto spot. Not verified from a primary source either way, so recorded as unknown (expected no, but unsourced).

median_spread_ticks_overnight.note: No published overnight (ETH) spread found for this product; CME 2023 rates review shows ETH/ATH ADV only as charts. Searched CME liquidity reports (2018 update, 2023 review), FEDS 2025-038, JSR 2015.

volume_per_minute.note: Not published for this product in any source found; A0 owns 1-minute bars for ZT..ZB (volume per minute is derivable there), none for the micro yields.

scheduled_releases_per_week.unit: auctions of the matching Treasury tenor per week (about 1 per month)
scheduled_releases_per_week.quote: 30-Year BOND Wednesday, August 05, 2026 Thursday, August 13, 2026 Monday, August 17, 2026
scheduled_releases_per_week.note: Each nominal coupon tenor is auctioned once a month (6 auctions per tenor in the 6-month schedule). Whether auctions count as product-specific releases or as the shared US macro calendar is for the scorer. Other tenors' auctions (2,3,5,7,10,20,30-year) total about 7 per month across the curve; bills several per week. No other product-specific scheduled release found.
